history.recommendation_text: The Board recommends that the Administration ensure that indicators in the senior managers’ compact are reviewed during the meeting of the Management Performance Board at the end of 2023, taking into consideration the findings mentioned above.
history.administration_response: During the 30 November 2023 meeting of the Management Performance Board, the Board recommended changes to compact indicators that were subsequently implemented in the 2024 compacts. The Administration is requesting the closure of this recommendation.
history.board_assessment: Two human resources indicators have been revised to better measure the progress towards improved geographical distribution and representation, and two oversight indicators have been measuring the implementation of the Board’s recommendations, which were revised to establish a 70 per cent target implementation rate. Additionally, the Secretary-General also endorsed the Management Performance Board’s recommendation to add “combatting racial discrimination in the workplace” as a new priority area for compacts starting in 2024, reflecting the senior leadership’s commitment to addressing racism and promoting dignity for all. The Board therefore considers the recommendation to be implemented.
